description: This file defines a StudentService module that provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for the 'students' table in a database, utilizing Supabase client. It includes functions to list students with pagination, retrieve individual students by ID, create new students, update existing students, and delete students. It also contains internal utility functions like error formatting.

methods.name: formatError(prefix, error)
methods.description: Formats error messages by prepending a prefix and extracting error message details.

methods.name: listStudents({ limit = 100, offset = 0, orderBy = "created_at", ascending = false } = {})
methods.description: Lists students with support for pagination and ordering.

methods.name: getStudentById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a student record by its unique ID.

methods.name: createStudent(payload)
methods.description: Creates a new student record with specified payload.

methods.name: updateStudent(id, updates)
methods.description: Updates a student's information based on ID and provided updates.

methods.name: deleteStudent(id)
methods.description: Deletes a student record by ID.

ctags.name: listStudents
ctags.pattern: /^export async function listStudents({ limit = 100, offset = 0, orderBy = "created_at", ascending /
